import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    L = np.log(T)
    A = params[0] + params[1]*L + params[2]*L**2 + params[3]*T + params[4]*T**1.5
    B = params[5] + params[6]*T**2 + params[7]*np.sqrt(T) + params[8]*np.exp(-1/T) + params[9]*np.exp(T)
    return A + B*eps**2
